pages.title: Dosing Pump
pages.text: A syringe driver that meters a substance in steadily, holding its level between too little and too much.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 3$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the dose and the interval. The level rises and falls as C = (D/V).e^(-kt); between doses it must stay above the effective level and below the toxic one. Too large a dose (over the toxic level) and it is wasted as a warning.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Stable Dose.
